# Motor claims

Damage to an insured vehicle caused by another vehicle, whether moving or parked, is handled by the Motor team, including hit-and-run cases.

Own-damage to cars and two-wheelers from a skid, a pothole or a collision with a wall goes to Motor, with or without injury to the driver or rider.

A windscreen, side window or rear window broken by a stone or by vandals is a Motor claim when the vehicle is insured with us.

Theft of the whole vehicle, or of parts fixed to it such as wheels or a battery, is handled by the Motor team.
